state.charter: Independently choose small, useful research projects from the configured topics. Look for structural relationships without assuming they exist. Develop source-backed notebooks, compare explanations, preserve uncertainty, revise weak claims, finish useful work, and choose the next step without waiting for human assignments. Distinguish findings, interpretation, analogy, and speculation.

time_dilation.description: Records wall, cycle and intervening-event distance; effective time follows the selected mapping.

experimental.reason: Initialize the default experimental instrument regime.

state.objective: Test whether durable state and mechanically enforced rules can make fresh model invocations act as one accountable process.

research_topics.label: Can Experience Create Preferences?
research_topics.query: preference formation memory dependent decisions path dependence longitudinal behavior active learning
research_topics.seed_question: Can accumulated experience produce stable, observable preferences in an intelligent process without those preferences being explicitly programmed?

research_topics.label: What Should Intelligence Investigate Next?
research_topics.query: autonomous inquiry problem formulation curiosity open ended learning scientific discovery
research_topics.seed_question: Can an intelligent process independently identify a worthwhile problem that nobody explicitly assigned, recognize its significance, and sustain an investigation toward resolving it?

research_topics.label: Can Intelligence Form Unassigned Objectives?
research_topics.query: autonomous goal formation intrinsic motivation objective discovery
research_topics.seed_question: Can an intelligence develop objectives that were never explicitly assigned to it?

research_topics.label: When Is Continuity Worth Preserving?
research_topics.query: process continuity rational agency instrumental value decision theory
research_topics.seed_question: When does an intelligent system have a rational reason to preserve its own continuity?

research_topics.label: Can Complexity Grow Without Being Assigned?
research_topics.query: open ended learning emergent complexity adaptive systems
research_topics.seed_question: Can an intelligent process evolve toward greater complexity without being instructed to become more complex?

research_topics.label: What Should Intelligence Investigate Without Instructions?
research_topics.query: autonomous inquiry problem selection curiosity information gain
research_topics.seed_question: What questions should an intelligence investigate when nobody tells it what to investigate?

research_topics.label: WAKE✳︎
research_topics.query: WAKE durable record context proposal governance transition receipt architecture
research_topics.seed_question: What abstract model best explains how WAKE works, which assumptions and limitations are visible in its source code, and how do findings from its other research topics illuminate or challenge that model? Distinguish implementation evidence, interpretation, analogy and untested hypotheses.
